citations.quote: The internal developer platform has been adopted by three of the five engineering teams. Payments and Growth are still on the legacy pipeline; Payments has a migration scheduled, Growth has not committed.
The platform working group is six engineers seconded part-time from three teams, chaired by Devika Nair.

rationale: The evidence shows the platform is used by three of five engineering teams, not every team, and that the candidate chaired a six-person working group that sets platform standards, so the claims of building it and of universal adoption are not supported as written.
